rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a year, whether as a duration or a calendar period.

example.english: This is my third year living in Hong Kong.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zyu6 zo2 saam1 nin4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the school year or academic year.

example.english: I want to join more activities in the new school year.
example.traditional: 新學年我想參加多啲活動。
example.jyutping: san1 hok6 nin4 ngo5 soeng2 caam1 gaa1 do1 di1 wut6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for a student's grade or year level rather than the period of the school year.

example.english: What year are you in now?
example.jyutping: nei5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 gei2 nin4 kap1 aa3
